description: Use this when the user likes a hotel but wants alternatives, e.g. 'like this one but cheaper' (cheaper_only). Returns hotels in the same destination with the closest comfort profile, none with repeated complaints about cleanliness, beds, showers, bugs or safety, with the price difference. Read-only, no sign-in.

cheaper_only.description: Only hotels priced below this one.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

hotel_id.description: Hotel id to find alternatives for.

max_price.description: Maximum price per night in USD.

name: find_similar_hotels
title: Find similar hotels
